items.html: *Know that there are four states in the world of Atzilut in the manner of the positioning of the male and the female that are there, both when they are Nekudot before the correction and when they are a complete Partzuf after the correction. And this is their order: the worst is that both are Achor be Achor [back to back]. Above this is Achor be Panim [back to face]; that is, the male turns his posterior toward the face of the female, for now the female can receive the light from the posterior of the male through her face, but from the face of the male she has as yet no power to receive the light. Above this is Panim be Achor [face to back]; that is, the male turns his face toward the posterior of the female and shines in her. And this is a greater virtue, for the light of the very face of the male shines in the female; only that she still has not enough power to receive it through the face, and therefore she turns her posterior and receives the light of the face itself through there, and through this the light is somewhat coarsened there. And when the light passes through the posterior and reaches her front side, she is already able to receive it, since it has been somewhat coarsened. And this is the secret of “and the wise one praises her at the back”: for Hochma, which is the male — when his face looks upon the posterior of the female and shines in her, he praises her and shines in her an additional illumination, more than were it the reverse, which is Achor be Panim, as above, which is the second degree.
